metadata.title: LUNAVI South Pole Analysis — computed visibility
metadata.sunCriterion: At least 50% of the solar disc above the modeled terrain horizon (50 % = the Sun's centre above it).
metadata.earthCriterion: Any part of Earth's disc above the modeled terrain horizon (the PGDA product 69 criterion). Geometric line of sight only — not a radio-link prediction.
metadata.referenceFrame: MOON_ME (mean Earth / polar axis), the frame of the LOLA PGDA DEMs; spherical local vertical, R = 1737.4 km
metadata.ephemeris: NAIF DE421 planetary ephemeris + MOON_ME (moon_080317.tf, moon_pa_de421_1900-2050.bpc)
assumptions: Observer 2 m above the DEM surface; horizon from rays every 0.5° out to 150 km, including lunar curvature.
DEM heights are metres above the 1737.4 km reference sphere (the LOLA LDEM convention).
Sun and Earth directions use LT+S aberration correction at the Moon's centre.
Times when the target lies in a horizon sector without complete DEM coverage are excluded from coverage (shown as unknown).
UTC to TDB through the loaded leapseconds kernel.
Default plan chosen automatically: the first whole-hour start where the plan meets both requirements, the +delay copy fails, and a recovery option exists.
limitations: Horizon accuracy is limited by DEM resolution and interpolation (about 90 % of PGDA product 78 pixels are interpolated).
Transition times are bisected to about ±30 s and displayed to the minute.

Visibility is geometric only: no thermal, radio-link or landing-safety modelling. The app's solar power estimate is experimental and its terrain values are characterization only, not a hazard assessment.

limitations: Terrain characterization only — not a landing safety certification or hazard assessment.
Computed from the LOLA DEM at its resolution; rocks, boulders and features smaller than about two pixels are not resolved.
Many DEM pixels are interpolated between LOLA tracks; slope and roughness inherit that interpolation.
The slope uncertainty is the statistical plane-fit error only; it does not include DEM error.
terrain.method: Least-squares plane over DEM pixel centres within the radius; slope from the plane gradient (per ground metre), roughness = RMS residual.
